editorial_note: Original writing informed by community discussions about both recognisable traits and tired stereotypes. These are creative sign-level lines, not personal natal-chart readings.

one_liners: Private, not mysterious. You just skipped the trust level.
I don't do halfway, including healing.
Read receipts off. Intuition on.
I saw the subtext before you finished the text.
Loyal beyond reason, gone beyond appeal.
My silence has already done the background check.
Intensity is only scary when honesty feels unfamiliar.
I can forgive you and still change the locks.
Dark humour, bright loyalty.
You met the calm version. The ocean stayed underneath.
I trust slowly and notice quickly.
My poker face has already written the case study.
You call it intense. I call it paying attention.
I do not need revenge when consequences have your address.
My soft side is invite-only and worth the application process.
I can smell a half-truth through a locked screen.
The mystery is mostly me minding my business.
I survived the plot twist and kept the screenshots.
Loyalty is not a mood. It is the whole contract.
I went quiet because the answer became obvious.
affirmations_predictions: The truth you name will free up energy you have spent hiding it.
Someone earns deeper access by respecting your first boundary.
A hard ending becomes useful when you stop reopening the door.
Your intensity finds a project strong enough to hold it.
You can protect your privacy without testing everyone's loyalty.
A difficult conversation reveals more devotion than suspicion expected.
The next transformation is quieter: less destruction, more release.
You will recognise power in choosing peace before revenge.
A secret stops controlling you once you choose where it can be spoken safely.
Your next bond deepens through consistency rather than forced confession.
You will notice when caution has turned into control and loosen your grip.
A shared resource or responsibility becomes fairer after direct negotiation.
Your ability to focus transforms a neglected goal.
Someone's actions will answer the question their words kept avoiding.
You can leave the old version behind without hating who you were.
A difficult truth becomes less dangerous in daylight.
Your privacy remains intact even when you let support in.
The next ending makes space instead of leaving a wound.
Your instincts sharpen when suspicion no longer has to lead them.
A loyal choice made now will matter long after the emotion settles.
micro_poems: what leaves you in the darkness
the locked room has a window,
a black rose drops its petals,
you do not fear the ending,
